subject.title: fix(channels): prevent prepared turn lifecycle leaks

question: Should prepared inbound turns without `runDispatchLifecycle` be rejected immediately for all external/plugin callers, or should a documented migration path be provided before enforcing this runtime guard?
rationale: The patch deliberately makes a plugin/kernel input contract stricter; the protected maintainer label and absent current-main ownership history prevent safely inferring the permanent public compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve strict inbound contract
options.body: Keep the runtime rejection and require lifecycle ownership for all prepared inbound turns after the owner confirms existing plugin callers are covered.

options.title: Stage compatibility migration
options.body: Keep the cleanup mechanism but add a documented temporary migration path if supported external callers can still return legacy prepared turns.

recommendation.title: Approve strict inbound contract
recommendation.body: Keep the runtime rejection and require lifecycle ownership for all prepared inbound turns after the owner confirms existing plugin callers are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this person as the author of the proposed contract and requested hardening change; deeper ownership history could not be inspected.
